text:
tess: Hey team — dropping the latest anchor + benchmark blurb for the Velocity Pulse launch blog. Need quick copy pass and legal clearance. Short thread pls.

omar: sharing the perf sheet: https://tiny.redwood/velocity-pulse-bench (view-only). Topline idea: 'Up to 2x throughput improvement and ~45% lower mean latency vs our classic serving config.'

miguel: nit: "throughput improvement" is vague. Can we phrase as "up to 2x sustained throughput for small-batch chat workloads"?

tess: good call. New hero: "Up to 2x sustained throughput for small-batch chat workloads and ~45% lower mean latency vs our classic serving config."

design-bot: can we get an animated demo gif for the hero — showing trace + QPS overlay? I can try a 10s loop.

omar: webinar ops note — proposing Mon 5/12 11am PT for the launch demo. Recommend 200 seats + waitlist.

tess: locking Mon 5/12 11am PT. Please reserve 200 seats and waitlist.

miguel: HubSpot mapping below (do not edit tags):

```json
{
  "utm_source": "velocity_blog",
  "utm_medium": "blog",
  "utm_campaign": "velocity_launch_may",
  "hs_lead_status": "marketing_interested",
  "tags": ["velocity_pulse","launch_may_2026"]
}
```

omar: legal-bot — can you run the claim sweep? We linked methodology and the public eval notebook in the sheet.

legal-bot: Automated scan: flagged absolute phrasing and missing dataset callout. Suggested footer: "Benchmark methodology: internal A/B runs across representative chat and reranking workloads; see methodology tab and public notebook for harness, datasets, warmup, and seed details." Manual review required for "up to 2x" and "~45%". Legal ops will reply within 48h.

tess: adding suggested footer and notebook link. Draft excerpt: 

"Today were introducing Velocity Pulse  a serving configuration tuned for small-batch chat workloads that can deliver up to 2x sustained throughput and ~45% lower mean latency compared to our classic serving config. Benchmark methodology: internal A/B runs across representative chat and reranking workloads; see methodology tab and public notebook for harness, datasets, warmup, and seed details. Register to join our live demo on Mon 5/12 at 11am PT and download the benchmark notebook."

miguel: PM check  LGTM, pls add a short link to the demo repo in the post.

tess: added demo repo link and hero gif request to design-bot.

design-bot: starting hero gif render, will drop in #design when ready. Prefer static fallback for email thumbnails.

omar: webinar ops ack  calendar invite drafted, Q&A 10m, recording enabled. Who moderates?

tess: Ill moderate; miguel will demo; omar takes live Q&A.

legal-bot: Manual review pending for numeric claims. Legal ops: will respond in-thread within 48 hours with signoff or edit suggestions.

tess: next steps: 1) legal quick-pass, 2) finalize hero gif/static fallback, 3) lock HubSpot UTMs + registration form, 4) schedule publish window pending legal. Please ack.

omar: ack  reserving seats and locking UTMs by EOD.

miguel: ack  demo checklist and repo links ready.

design-bot: ack  gif render in progress, static fallback exported.

tess: thanks team — holding publish until legal signs off then moving to the publish queue. :thumbsup:
